activities.activity_name: Design namespace handling for tenant isolation
activities.activity_description: Define how tenant-specific namespaces will be dynamically configured and managed in ZK.
Modify configuration and code to support dynamic namespace switching per tenant.
Verify that tenant metadata is correctly isolated using the new namespace logic.
Plan the login mechanism for Admin server access using username/password.
Code the authentication logic using Spring Security and ensure password is not logged.
Validate login functionality and ensure no password exposure in logs.
Set up a dedicated branch for minor releases (e.g., 1.0.2).
Configure build and deployment pipelines for the maintenance branch.
Write documentation for committing minor releases to the maintenance branch.
Audit codebase to locate deprecated functions (e.g., module definition downloads).
Delete deprecated functions and update dependent modules (Shell, Admin-UI).
Ensure no regressions occur after removing deprecated functions.
Evaluate connecting xd-shell directly to ZK versus using a load balancer for port discovery.
Define how xd-shell will retrieve the admin server's random port from ZK.
Code the logic to fetch and use the random port from ZK in xd-shell.
Verify xd-shell can successfully connect to the admin server via ZK.
Integrate Kafka's updated consumer API into the codebase.
Execute existing tests with the new Kafka consumer implementation.
Address any test failures caused by the Kafka consumer upgrade.
Investigate implementation of Motion-JPEG for streaming audio/video data.
Define technical specifications for Motion-JPEG streaming and OpenCV integration.
Develop the streaming pipeline using FFmpeg and OpenCV for facial detection.
Validate Motion-JPEG streaming and facial detection functionality.
Introduce a boolean flag in servers.yml to enable/disable message rates.
Code the logic to show/hide message rates in the cluster view based on the config.
Verify that the message rate toggle works as expected in the cluster view.
